decision: Keep as the current statically validated bare-model candidate. Do not claim faster laps, higher completion, SOTA or submission readiness without an authorized controlled driving evaluation.
implementation: Recover the complete contiguous asphalt run associated with the tracked road at rows30,34,42 and54; suppress the racing line when any registered span is missing or ambiguous.

Use the full row54 safe envelope for persistent outside/inside/outside targets with at least7 image pixels of center-to-edge clearance. Compute row42 and row54 virtual anchors from their own perspective widths.
Track entry and exit with a directionally convergent near-lateral plus far-to-near heading law. Preserve inherited curvature steering at apex and add only signed inside-position correction.
Hold the exit outside target on the following straight until it is reached for two consecutive clear frames, while allowing new bend evidence to take priority.

Preserve the synchronized completion controller's obstacle action unless it would steer farther through an already reached edge; in that case slew centerward, command gas0 and brake0.28, and synchronize the shadow state to every guarded output.
